description: Study Mode focus view: while Study Mode is on, elements matching "hide" are hidden on the listed sites, and requests starting with a "blockRequests" prefix (host/path) are refused. By default only what plays or sells without a click is removed (hover previews, animated thumbnails, ads); anything you click is checked by Study Mode anyway. Selectors only: anything with { } ; @ or comments is ignored. To also hide YouTube recommendations or comments, add for example "ytd-watch-flexy #secondary" or "ytd-comments".

note.text: StudyNest focus view: hover previews and ads are off. Any video you open is checked first.
